name: Set Policy Title
description: Set the title on an existing business policy. Takes the numeric policy id returned by Create Blank Policy. A policy created without a title is an untitled orphan in the catalog, so always call this immediately after creating one, before creating the next policy.

policy_id.description: Numeric id of the policy to title. Must be an id returned by Create Blank Policy in this conversation — never from memory, inference, or a guess at a sequence.

value.description: The policy title as plain text. No HTML. Do not prefix it with the regulation id unless the user asked for a namespace prefix.
